# Fingerprint of the headers that make up ShaderState, the format of
# shader-list.bin and shader-list-mine.bin. The release workflow checks it on
# every push to main and releases nothing when it does not match: a different
# ShaderState makes xemu reject the shipped and learned shader lists, which
# quietly turns shader precache off for every player.
#
# When it fails:
#   - the layout really changed (fields added, removed or resized): ship a
#     converter for both lists in the same build, then update the line below;
#   - only comments or code changed in those headers: just update the line.
# The new line is printed in the failed run's error. Files, in this order:
#   hw/xbox/nv2a/pgraph/glsl/shaders.h vsh.h geom.h psh.h
#   hw/xbox/nv2a/pgraph/vsh_regs.h psh_regs.h
953de0c57d1eb9a6fba8659e2f9a765dd1d64cc9b7ee71d4da45e9c702022ea5
